note.en: Interrupt-capable GPIO pad coverage is not fully established from the available WL82 sources; the pinout lists SDK logical GPIO codes.
note.zh-CN: 现有 WL82 资料无法完整确认支持中断的 GPIO 焊盘范围；引脚表列出的是 SDK 逻辑 GPIO 编号。

note.en: GPIO count and pinout list only the 41 GPIO-capable pads shown on the JL_AC79_WIFI V1.0 coreboard connector table: PA0-PA10, PB0-PB8, PC0-PC10 and PH0-PH9. This is not the full WL82 SDK logical address space. The remaining codes within 0-127 are not confirmed as physically exposed on this board. These pads are muxed with board functions; disconnect or reconfigure the default functions before using a pad as ordinary GPIO. USB-special pins are excluded from this ordinary GPIO count.
note.zh-CN: GPIO 数量和引脚表仅列出 JL_AC79_WIFI V1.0 核心板连接器表明确引出的 41 个 GPIO-capable pad：PA0–PA10、PB0–PB8、PC0–PC10、PH0–PH9。这不是 WL82 SDK 的完整逻辑地址空间；不能据此代码确认其余 0–127 编号已在本板物理引出。上述引脚与板载功能复用，作为普通 GPIO 前须断开或重配默认功能。USB 专用脚不计入普通 GPIO 数量。
